item: D5 Selection of the reported result
support_quote: The scale is divided into five aspects: internal regulation aspect, identity regulation aspect, interjective regulation aspect, external regulation aspect, and motivation ( 22 ).
reasoning: Both judges read the paper correctly. The Methods name five BREQ-2 aspects, and Table 2 and §3.2 give one total per arm at all three time points. The registration (NCT06216236) gives no date and no outcomes in the saved text. Judge 1 reads the High anchor's 'only some of the subscales' as covering a total reported in place of every subscale. Judge 2 reads it as covering only a subset, which a whole-instrument total is not. The anchor's wording supports both readings. The user's question: when the Methods describe an instrument's subscales and the report gives only a total or composite (no subscale), does that meet D5 High's 'gives only some of the subscales ... that its methods ... say were administered'?
